mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_definition (id, tenant_id, code, name, scope_type, project_id, status, current_version, model_schema_version, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{scopeType}, #{projectId}, 'DRAFT', 0, #{modelSchemaVersion}, 0)

INSERT INTO wf_version (id, tenant_id, definition_id, version_no, definition_json, model_schema_version, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, 1, #{definitionJson}, #{modelSchemaVersion}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_definition SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, model_schema_version = #{modelSchemaVersion} WHERE id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE wf_version SET definition_json = #{definitionJson}, model_schema_version = #{modelSchemaVersion} WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE wf_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', bpmn_xml = #{bpmnXml}, deployment_id = #{deploymentId}, node_mapping_json = #{nodeMappingJson} WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

UPDATE wf_definition SET status = 'PUBLISHED', current_version = #{versionNo}, model_schema_version = #{modelSchemaVersion}, bpmn_xml = #{bpmnXml}, deployment_id = #{deploymentId}, node_mapping_json = #{nodeMappingJson} WHERE id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_version (id, tenant_id, definition_id, version_no, definition_json, model_schema_version, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, #{versionNo}, #{definitionJson}, #{modelSchemaVersion}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_definition SET status = 'DRAFT', current_version = #{versionNo}, bpmn_xml = NULL, deployment_id = NULL, node_mapping_json = NULL WHERE id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_instance (id, tenant_id, definition_id, version_no, business_key, business_module_code, business_module_name, business_type, business_title, business_round, project_id, project_ref, project_name, action_path, data_digest, status, starter_id, flowable_process_instance_id, flowable_process_definition_id, variables_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, #{versionNo}, #{businessKey}, #{businessModuleCode}, #{businessModuleName}, #{businessType}, #{businessTitle}, #{businessRound}, #{projectId}, #{projectRef}, #{projectName}, #{actionPath}, #{dataDigest}, 'RUNNING', #{starterId}, #{flowableProcessInstanceId}, #{flowableProcessDefinitionId}, #{variablesJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET assignee_id = #{targetUserId}, assignee_name = (SELECT display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{targetUserId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE wf_task SET status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE wf_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id <> #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE wf_instance SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status, flowable_task_id, action_key) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskKey}, #{nodeId}, 'APPROVAL', #{taskGroupKey}, #{assigneeType}, #{assigneeName}, #{assigneeId}, 'PENDING', #{flowableTaskId}, #{actionKey})

INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status, comment, completed_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, 'cc', 'cc', 'CC', #{taskGroupKey}, 'USER', #{assigneeName}, #{assigneeId}, 'SENT', #{comment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO wf_task_action (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_id, action_code, operator_id, target_user_id, comment, payload_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{actionCode}, #{operatorId}, #{targetUserId}, #{comment}, #{payloadJson})

INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, parent_task_id, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status) SELECT #{taskId}, instance_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, 'ADD_SIGN', #{taskGroupKey}, id, 'USER', (SELECT display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{targetUserId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}), #{targetUserId}, 'PENDING' FROM wf_task WHERE id = #{sourceTaskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.task_key, t.node_id, t.task_type, t.status, COALESCE(t.assignee_name, u.display_name) AS assignee_name, t.created_at, i.business_key, i.status AS instance_status FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id AND u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND t.flowable_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT') ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT i.id, i.definition_id, d.name AS definition_name, i.version_no, i.business_key, i.status, i.starter_id, u.display_name AS starter_name, i.created_at FROM wf_instance i JOIN wf_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.tenant_id = i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.starter_id AND u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY i.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.event_type, a.operator_id, u.display_name AS operator_name, a.reason, a.payload_json, a.created_at FROM wf_audit_event a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.operator_id AND u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.created_at, a.id

SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, i.definition_id, i.version_no, i.project_id, t.flowable_task_id, t.task_key, t.assignee_id FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.flowable_task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 'PENDING'
SELECT id, code, name, scope_type, project_id, status, current_version, model_schema_version, deployment_id FROM wf_definition WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT d.id, d.code, d.name, d.scope_type, d.project_id, d.current_version, d.deployment_id, v.definition_json FROM wf_definition d JOIN wf_version v ON v.definition_id = d.id AND v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.version_no = d.current_version WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT version_no, definition_json, model_schema_version, node_mapping_json FROM wf_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT definition_json, node_mapping_json, model_schema_version FROM wf_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT id, definition_id, version_no, business_key, status, project_id, flowable_process_instance_id, flowable_process_definition_id, starter_id FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT starter_id FROM wf_instance WHERE flowable_process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT id, display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND flowable_task_id = #{flowableTaskId} AND assignee_id = #{assigneeId}
SELECT status FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
